name: Zimone Wola
description: Zimone Wola is a mathematical prodigy who earned early admission to Strixhaven, studied at Quandrix, and survived Duskmourn.

bio.text: Zimone chose Quandrix, and she learned that her grandmother Nimiroti had solved the Vorzani Conjecture and been captured by the Oriq, then cast a memory-loss spell on herself.

citations.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

bio.text: The Oriq captured her because Extus Narr wanted her knowledge, and she rescued him when Kianne and her friends came.

citations.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Captured by the Oriq". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the New Phyrexian Invasion she helped Dina build a ritual to open a hole to the air, and the students read the Invocation of the Founders on the roof.

bio.text: She went into Duskmourn with Kaito, Niko, Tyvar and the Wanderer to retrieve Nashi, and she and Tyvar found Marina Vendrell's diary, which showed that Marina enabled Valgavoth to take over the plane.

bio.text: Zimone and Tyvar rescued Nashi, Niko and the Wanderer from the cult and escaped through an Omenpath that Kaito opened from Ravnica.

bio.text: As a Quandrix graduate, she modelled the Multiverse and concluded that someone was duplicating it, and after dividing herself into doubles she reintegrated them, and she and Dina traced the caster to Chandra Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Zimone waits in Firejolt Café counting bubbles on the last day of exams.
timeline.quote: Zimone Wola counts the clusters of bubbles floating in her glass of Kiwano Fizzy Pop.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone recalls Dean Kianne urging her to consider Quandrix.
timeline.quote: Please tell me you are considering Quandrix College for next year.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The three friends have each chosen different colleges.
timeline.quote: Zimone chose Quandrix, Amaka Prismari, and Nnanyielugo Silverquill.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Wallader tells Zimone a mystery package arrived for her two weeks ago.
timeline.quote: A package came in for you two weeks ago.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes she knows who sent the package, one she has received for seven years.
timeline.quote: she has received the same package, just like the one Wallader described, for seven years now

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: On her seventh birthday, Zimone received her first box of eight blue-green ribbons from her grandmother (flashback).
timeline.quote: Inside the velveteen-lined box were eight green-and-blue-striped ribbons and a note

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone learns pieces of the story that her grandmother left Strixhaven after forgetting things and was never seen again (flashback).
timeline.quote: that she left Strixhaven and was never seen again

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Silverquill wins the Mage Tower game after hypnotizing Quandrix's captain.
timeline.quote: Silverquill College won even though one of their players hypnotized Quandrix College's captain at the finals.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone counts 377 ribbons and reads that this will be the last package.
timeline.quote: So, this will be the last one.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dean Imbraham teaches theory to second-year Quandrix mages.
timeline.quote: The most important thing you have to know about theory is that it is just substance we haven't figured out yet

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Imbraham tells Zimone she looks like her grandmother, whom he once taught.
timeline.quote: Your grandmother, Nimiroti Wola. Taught her in this same class many years ago.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Imbraham praises Nimiroti as the best student he ever taught.
timeline.quote: The best student I've ever taught.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kianne tells Zimone her name is who she is.
timeline.quote: At this point, Zimone Wola is more than your name.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone takes out the Vorzani Conjecture book from the Biblioplex, last signed out by Nimiroti.
timeline.quote: Zimone had peeped into the record scroll as Isabough's branches reached to the farthest shelves to find the book.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone finds a note in her grandmother's handwriting hidden in the book.
timeline.quote: Packages of Ribbons. Numbers one step backward to go on forever. Living books that talk to you on the pathway of light.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone dreams of the Arithmodrome crumbling as she tries to save a woman braiding ribbons.
timeline.quote: Zimone races toward her to save her, because the Arithmodrome is crumbling.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kianne suspects Zimone and Imbraham of pursuing the Vorzani Conjecture and Zimone resists.
timeline.quote: Fear that I will find out what you and Dean Imbraham have been up to.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The Codex Vocifera tells Zimone that Nimiroti solved the Vorzani Conjecture and was captured by the Oriq.
timeline.quote: Nimiroti figured out the Vorzani Conjecture.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone's ribbon braid weaves itself into patterns as she senses danger.
timeline.quote: The braid, as if it has a mind of its own, weaves into countless patterns.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone hits her head on a torch and loses consciousness.
timeline.quote: She spins to investigate but trips and slams her head against one of the torches.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone wakes to find Extus and Pita, who introduce themselves.
timeline.quote: My name is Extus

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus says they have followed Zimone for years and know about the packages.
timeline.quote: We have followed you for years.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus offers to share what the Oriq knows about the Conjecture to control the universe.
timeline.quote: And we'll tell you what we know, and together, we can control the universe.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone refuses and lashes Extus and Pita into a wall with the ribbon braid.
timeline.quote: whips the braid of blue-green ribbons at the two men, sending them crashing into the wall at the far end of the room

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Pita argues Strixhaven hoards magic and that destroying it would spread magic to all.
timeline.quote: If we destroy it, then anyone anywhere in the world can practice magic.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kianne redirects Extus's fireball, and Zimone stops and douses it with her braid.
timeline.quote: Zimone swirls the braid of blue-green ribbons, weaving it into the tiny cracks of time and space

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus departs, saying they will meet again.
timeline.quote: Though I trust we'll meet again, Zimone Wola.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rumors spread that Zimone is an Oriq recruit and her friends avoid her.
timeline.quote: somehow, the rumor of her being an Oriq recruit spread around Strixhaven

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone visits Nimiroti at the Sanctuary of the Lost and finds her braiding ribbons into her hair.
timeline.quote: Nimiroti is sitting beside the window with her back turned, braiding stripes of blue-green ribbons into her graying locks.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Nimiroti, who no longer remembers her, tells Zimone she is someone she loves.
timeline.quote: I don't know who you are, but I know you're someone I love.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The Oriq take notice of Zimone's brilliance.
timeline.quote: Zimone's brilliance drew attention from many, including the sinister mages known as the Oriq.

citation.text: Solve the Equation (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zimone's grandmother Nimiroti had solved the Vorzani Conjecture and was captured by the Oriq, then cast a memory-loss spell on herself.
timeline.quote: Nimiroti had to cast a memory loss spell on herself to erase her knowledge of the Conjecture from her mind

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Captured by the Oriq". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Oriq capture Zimone, and Extus Narr wants her knowledge; Zimone rescues him when Kianne and her friends come, showing she has mastered time and space.
timeline.quote: she demonstrated that she had mastered time and space, and thus had solved the Vorzani Conjecture

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Captured by the Oriq". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rumors that Zimone is in league with the Oriq isolate her; she eventually finds Nimiroti at a sanctuary for people damaged by magic.
timeline.quote: Zimone eventually found Nimiroti at a sanctuary for people damaged by magic.

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Captured by the Oriq". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When the Phyrexians invade, Vess sends the surviving students to find the Invocation of the Founders in the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Dina blend Quandrix mathematics and Witherbloom biology into new interdisciplinary magic against the invaders.
timeline.quote: they blended their magics and found to their delight

citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Quint and four students search the tunnels beneath Strixhaven for the Invocation of the Founders.
timeline.quote: I wonder if the invocation will really slow the Phyrexian invasion, like Professor Vess said.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students climb into the Biblioplex and find it overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree, with the invocation's motes fighting the gloom.
timeline.quote: His lovely, luminous center of learning was gone.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students flee through the Biblioplex, fighting back with magic.
timeline.quote: They didn't even speak. They just ran.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students sneak through the Biblioplex avoiding patrolling professors, and Quint summons a statue spirit that shouts at a professor to save Zimone.
timeline.quote: No talking in the library!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They find the Invocation of the Founders on a platform and discover it is partially alive and shields them from Phyrexian attention.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us from Phyrexian attention.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dina and Zimone build a ritual to blast a hole to open air, while a professor attacks and the invocation folds into a pocket-sized ball.
timeline.quote: he grabbed it and rammed it into his pocket, out of sight

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The ritual's overload turns the Biblioplex's bookcases into a huge tree that smashes through the ceiling.
timeline.quote: and kept growing , boughs forming a perfect helix of steps

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students read the five petals of the invocation on the roof, describing Strixhaven's nature back to itself.
timeline.quote: They told Strixhaven what it was, and in that telling, there was no room for Phyrexia.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Dina, Killian, Zimone and Rootha injured, and Killian digs out his father alive.
timeline.quote: but alive, and himself.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Invocation is activated; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away, but the attackers are repelled.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians burn through Strixhaven's defenses and Vess sends surviving students to find the Invocation.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Vess sends surviving students to activate the Invocation of the Founders; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: in the process, Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Dina blend Quandrix and Witherbloom magic to fight, discovering new interdisciplinary magic.
timeline.quote: Zimone enhanced Dina's plant growth

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When a door to Duskmourn opens on Ravnica, Etrata and Proft help retrieve Nashi from the plane.
timeline.quote: When a door to Duskmourn opened on Ravnica, the two assisted Kaito Shizuki

citation.text: "Etrata", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet helps the Wanderer search for Nashi, whose door has appeared on Ravnica, and assigns Zimone to the party going to Duskmourn.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet assisted the Wanderer in her search for Nashi

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet and Ral offer Zimone an apprenticeship in the Omenpath Project.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet and Ral Zarek extended an offer of apprenticeship to Zimone Wola

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaito meets Zimone, a Strixhaven student sent by Niv-Mizzet to wait for him.
timeline.quote: I'm Zimone. I'm a student? Quandrix College, at Strixhaven University.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone leads the group to a courtyard where Kaito presents Tyvar and Niko to the dragon Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: The alley ended in a small courtyard, dominated by a massive red dragon lounging on the far side like a cat

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone reports that Nashi's drones recorded a house with distorted space on the other side.
timeline.quote: Just a house, perfectly normal, if in need of a good cleaning service.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The team takes Etrata's monitoring devices and files through the door into the House.
timeline.quote: One by one, the group filed inside.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The party moves down a dusty hallway and discovers the door they came through has vanished.
timeline.quote: The door's gone

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes the room is not the one Nashi's drone recorded, so the House rearranges itself.
timeline.quote: This isn't the same room that it recorded.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer finds a family photo with the adults' faces scratched out and the daughter smiling.
timeline.quote: The faces of the adults had been scratched out, reduced to white scabs on the paper

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko proposes a right-hand search pattern, as in Theros labyrinth exercises, and leads the party.
timeline.quote: We take the right-hand turn and keep following to the right until and unless we wind up back where we started.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The party finds an abandoned funfair in a cornfield beyond glass doors, but Zimone shows the sky is a glass ceiling, so it is still the House.
timeline.quote: If they were indoors, there could be no breeze, and without a breeze, why was it moving?

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A voice cries for help and Tyvar runs toward it; Zimone chases him.
timeline.quote: Tyvar's thin leash on his own heroic urges snapped, and he took off running

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone races after Tyvar through the doorway as something shatters beside her head and the ballroom disappears.
timeline.quote: Something shattered on the doorway next to her head as she ran through

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone find an empty hall with no one in danger and conclude the House is playing tricks.
timeline.quote: On the other side of the door was an empty hall.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The doorway behind Tyvar and Zimone becomes a solid wall papered with moths, separating them from the others.
timeline.quote: where the doorway back to the ballroom should have been, was a wall

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone discover their hallway has turned into a towering library when they stopped looking.
timeline.quote: They were no longer in a hallway.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar turns his skin to wood and punches through the wall, finding a stairway beyond.
timeline.quote: Tyvar's skin rippled, taking on the hardwood sheen of the floor beneath his feet

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone ties a fractal thread to Tyvar and stays in the library to study the books while he climbs the stairs.
timeline.quote: I'll keep the other one, and hopefully that means we won't lose each other.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar's climb leads back into the same library, where Zimone waits.
timeline.quote: He was back in the library.
